candidates.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
candidates.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

candidates.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
candidates.summary: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees, helping teams research, analyze data, create presentations, and complete complex workflows.

candidates.title: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them
candidates.summary: Many teams build a multi-agent AI prototype in days but hit a wall in production. This post defines five production challenges (orchestration, per-agent model selection, reliable operation, secure code execution, and monitoring) and shows how Deep Insight, an open source multi-agent system on AWS, solves each.

candidates.title: Adaptive agentic intelligence framework using Strands Agents
candidates.summary: The Adaptive Agentic Intelligence Framework (AAIF), built with Strands Agents, handles routine tasks locally with small language models and routes complex requests to cloud models through Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through building AAIF with local SLMs through Ollama and Amazon Bedrock, using an Internet of Things monitoring scenario.
